SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.DESCRIPTION AS description, P.PRICE AS price, PC.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, B.BRAND_NAME AS brandName,
IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0) AS ratingAvg, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS reviewCount,
( SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' ORDER BY PI.SORT_ORDER ASC, PI.IMAGE_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbImgUrl
FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY PC ON P.CATEGORY_ID = PC.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN BRAND B ON P.BRAND_ID = B.BRAND_ID LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID AND R.REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE ( P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PC.CATEGORY_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.BRAND_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.DESCRIPTION, P.PRICE, PC.CATEGORY_NAME, B.BRAND_NAME
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY PC ON P.CATEGORY_ID = PC.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN BRAND B ON P.BRAND_ID = B.BRAND_ID WHERE ( P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PC.CATEGORY_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.BRAND_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT F.FAQ_ID AS faqId, F.QUESTION AS question, F.ANSWER AS answer, F.CATEGORY AS category FROM FAQ F WHERE F.QUESTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR F.ANSWER LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY F.FAQ_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAQ F WHERE F.QUESTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR F.ANSWER LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT E.EVENT_ID AS eventId, E.TITLE AS title, E.CONTENT AS content, DATE_FORMAT(E.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startAt, DATE_FORMAT(E.END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endAt, EI.IMG_URL AS thumbImgUrl FROM EVENT E LEFT JOIN EVENT_IMG EI ON E.EVENT_ID = EI.EVENT_ID AND EI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE E.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR E.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY E.EVENT_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT E WHERE E.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR E.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT C.CAMP_ID AS campId, C.CAMP_NAME AS campName, C.ADDRESS AS address, C.DESCRIPTION AS description, C.INDUTY AS induty, CI.IMG_URL AS thumbImgUrl FROM CAMP C LEFT JOIN CAMP_IMG CI ON C.CAMP_ID = CI.CAMP_ID WHERE C.CAMP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.ADDRESS LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.INDUTY LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY C.CAMP_ID, C.CAMP_NAME, C.ADDRESS, C.DESCRIPTION, C.INDUTY, CI.IMG_URL ORDER BY C.CAMP_ID DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CAMP C WHERE C.CAMP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.ADDRESS LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.INDUTY LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT B.BOARD_ID AS boardId, B.TITLE AS title, B.CONTENT AS content, B.CATEGORY AS category, B.USER_ID AS userId,
U.NICKNAME AS nickName, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS profileImg,
B.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, B.LIKE_COUNT AS likeCount, B.DISLIKE_COUNT AS dislikeCount, B.COMMENT_COUNT AS commentCount,
DATE_FORMAT(B.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,
( SELECT BI.IMG_URL FROM BOARD_IMG BI WHERE BI.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID ORDER BY BI.SORT_ORDER ASC, BI.IMG_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbImgUrl
FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN USER U ON B.USER_ID = U.USER_ID
WHERE B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ( B.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR U.NICKNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY B.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN USER U ON B.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ( B.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR U.NICKNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
